title: Pulpo native keyboard public-behavior workload
authorship: Blind independent authorship from the user-provided public description only.
execution_conventions: Execute manually using only public keyboard, settings, picker, and plain-text host UI. No internal instrumentation is required.

Use a plain-text host field with selection and text inspection. Prepare stated host text and caret through the host UI before each case. Disable host-owned text transformations and keep OS audio/haptic conditions stable where relevant.

Prepare each case independently. Explicitly stated within-case history must be retained. Initial toggle and language values are fixtures set through public settings and applied by returning to the keyboard.

For exact text comparisons, compare the full host value at the stated checkpoints. Letter tap sequences deliberately avoid spaces and punctuation. Do not accept query leakage, unsolicited insertion, or deletion.

E, A, B, T, P, and W are per-case recorded observations, not fixed emoji or word identities. Compare emoji by the full selected displayed sequence, including its tone; do not assume a single code point. Record these observations before dependent actions.
A search-selection case requires a visible result for the specified ordinary query; if none is offered, record that step as blocked rather than inventing a result or substituting a ranking oracle.

A recent-history fixture requires a recorded existing recent emoji. For EN-04, record the initial recent list and choose a visible non-recent emoji. For BI-04, record the initial list so newly created entries can be distinguished from existing ones.
Gesture paths use visible letter keys; move continuously and release on the final letter. Cursor-edit steps terminate at a visible caret position, with no fixed distance, velocity, or pixel mapping.

Sound means system keyboard clicks. Physical audibility and tactile haptics cannot be established on a simulator; record those checks as not observable there, while still executing preference and text checks.

Do not score prediction order, autocorrect quality, exact slide-recognition spelling, dictionary coverage, population superiority, timing thresholds, or undocumented persistence across reinstall/reboot. Only EN-04 requires keyboard dismissal/reopening.

cases.initial_state: English selected and applied by returning to the keyboard; empty plain-text host field; alphabet layout visible.
actions: Tap lowercase h, j, k without space or punctuation.
expected_outcomes: The host contains exactly "hjk".
The insertion point is after k.
cases.rationale: Positive literal letter-entry control without a word-boundary autocorrect or prediction oracle.

cases.initial_state: Español selected and applied by returning to the keyboard; empty plain-text host field; alphabet layout visible.
actions: Tap lowercase j, k, h without space or punctuation.
expected_outcomes: The host contains exactly "jkh".
The insertion point is after h.
cases.rationale: Independent Spanish-mode literal-entry control using letters shared by the supported layouts.

cases.initial_state: English + Español selected and applied by returning to the keyboard; empty plain-text host field; alphabet layout visible.
actions: Tap lowercase k, h, j without space or punctuation.
expected_outcomes: The host contains exactly "khj".
The insertion point is after j.
cases.rationale: Bilingual-mode literal-entry control without language detection or ranking assumptions.

cases.initial_state: English active; host contains exactly "hjkh" with caret at the end; alphabet layout visible.
actions: Hold the space bar to enter cursor editing.
Slide left until the visible caret is between j and k, then release.
Tap lowercase j.
expected_outcomes: Before the final tap, the host still contains exactly "hjkh" and the caret is between j and k.
After the tap, the host contains exactly "hjjkh".
The hold/slide adds no space and deletes no text.
cases.rationale: Checks visible cursor placement and subsequent insertion without assuming a pixel-to-character mapping.

cases.initial_state: Español active; host contains exactly "kjhk" with caret at the end; alphabet layout visible.
actions: Hold the space bar and slide left until the caret is between the first k and j.
While still holding, slide right until the caret is between h and the final k; release.
Tap lowercase j.
expected_outcomes: The host remains exactly "kjhk" throughout cursor movement.
After release, the caret is between h and the final k.
After the tap, the host contains exactly "kjhjk" with no added space.
cases.rationale: Exercises cursor reversal and editing continuity in Spanish mode.

cases.initial_state: English + Español active; host contains exactly "hjkh" with caret between j and k; alphabet layout visible.
actions: Open the emoji picker.
Close the picker through its visible return-to-letters control without selecting an emoji.
Tap lowercase j.
expected_outcomes: Opening and closing the picker leaves the host exactly "hjkh" and preserves the insertion position.
The final host value is exactly "hjjkh".
cases.rationale: Negative emoji-selection control and caret continuity across a keyboard-local panel.

cases.initial_state: English active; host contains exactly "hjkh" with caret between j and k; emoji picker available.
actions: Open the emoji picker and its search field.
Type lowercase s, u, n into the keyboard search field.
Replace the query with lowercase c, a, t using search-field editing.
Clear the query and return to letters without selecting a result.
expected_outcomes: The search field reads exactly "sun", then exactly "cat", then is empty at the respective checkpoints.
At every checkpoint and after returning to letters, the host remains exactly "hjkh" with caret between j and k.
No emoji is inserted.
cases.rationale: Deterministic query editing and host isolation without asserting search results or ordering.

cases.initial_state: Español active; host contains exactly "kjhk" with caret at the end; emoji picker available.
actions: Open emoji search.
Type lowercase s, o, l into the search field.
Delete l with one backspace, then type l again.
Clear the query and return to letters without selecting a result.
Tap lowercase j.
expected_outcomes: The query reads exactly "sol", then "so", then "sol", then is empty.
Before the final letter tap, the host remains exactly "kjhk" with caret at the end.
After the final tap, the host contains exactly "kjhkj".
No query letter or query backspace changes host text.
cases.rationale: Spanish query deletion control plus continuity when leaving keyboard-local search.

cases.initial_state: English + Español active; host contains exactly "hjk" with caret at the end; emoji picker available.
actions: Open emoji search and enter exactly "sun".
Choose a single visible emoji result, recording its displayed emoji as E before tapping it.
Return to letters if necessary and tap lowercase k.
expected_outcomes: Typing the query leaves the host exactly "hjk".
Immediately after the result tap, the host contains exactly "hjk" followed by one E.
After the letter tap, the host contains exactly "hjk" followed by E followed by "k".
The query text "sun" is never inserted into the host.
cases.rationale: Positive search-to-host insertion using the actual selected result, independent of result identity and rank.

cases.initial_state: English active; host is empty; recent-emoji history may contain any existing entries; emoji picker available.
actions: In the regular emoji picker, select a visible emoji E that is not in the current recent list; record its displayed value before selecting.
Inspect the recent-emoji view.
Dismiss and reopen the keyboard on the same host field.
Open recent emojis and select E once.
expected_outcomes: After the first selection, the host contains exactly one E.
E appears in recent emojis after selection and after keyboard reopening; its position is unconstrained.
After the second selection, the host contains exactly E followed by E.
cases.rationale: Positive recency creation and reopen-history control without requiring an empty history, fixed ordering, or a particular emoji.

cases.initial_state: Español active; empty host; an existing recent emoji A is recorded; a visible tone-capable emoji B, distinct from A, is available.
actions: Open the skin-tone choices for B through the picker’s visible tone-choice interaction.
Record one displayed non-default tone variant as T and select it.
Open recent emojis and select that same displayed T once.
expected_outcomes: The host contains exactly one T after tone selection.
Recent emojis offers the selected T; its position is unconstrained.
After selecting T from recents, the host contains exactly T followed by T.
A remains available in recent emojis after adding this single choice.
cases.rationale: Positive tone selection and exact variant reuse, with a prior-history continuity control; no Unicode code-point-count assumption.

cases.initial_state: English + Español active; host contains exactly "hjk"; recent emojis contains recorded emoji A; a visible tone-capable emoji B is available.
actions: Open the skin-tone choices for B.
Dismiss the choices without selecting a variant.
Open emoji search, type exactly "cat", clear it, and close the picker without selecting an emoji.
Inspect recent emojis.
expected_outcomes: The host remains exactly "hjk" throughout.
A remains present in recent emojis.
Opening and dismissing the tone choices does not create a new recent entry for B or one of its variants that was absent at the start.
Query-only activity does not create any new recent emoji entry.
cases.rationale: Negative history controls distinguish browsing and search editing from actual emoji selection.

cases.initial_state: English active; Slide to Type on; Show Slide Trail on; empty host; alphabet layout visible.
actions: In settings, turn Slide to Type off and return to the keyboard.
In one continuous contact, touch h, move over j and k, and release over k.
Record the resulting host text as P.
Tap lowercase h, j, k separately without a word boundary.
Reopen settings.
expected_outcomes: The continuous contact does not commit a word inferred from its path; any ordinary key press caused by touching a key is allowed and recorded in P.
Separate taps append exactly "hjk" to P.
Slide to Type remains off and Show Slide Trail remains on in settings.
cases.rationale: Negative gesture control and preference independence; avoids assuming how a disabled gesture handles its initial key touch.

cases.initial_state: Español active; Slide to Type on; Show Slide Trail on; empty host; alphabet layout visible.
actions: Slide continuously through c, a, s, a and release; record the committed text as W without judging its spelling.
Clear the host using host editing.
Turn Show Slide Trail off in settings and return to the keyboard.
Slide through c, a, s, a again and release.
Reopen settings.
expected_outcomes: With both settings on, a visible trail follows the moving contact and disappears after release; release commits nonempty text W.
With Show Slide Trail off, no slide trail is visible during the second gesture, and release still commits nonempty text.
Slide to Type remains on and Show Slide Trail remains off.
No equality, ranking, spelling, or relative accuracy requirement is imposed on the two committed texts.
cases.rationale: Positive slide-entry behavior and independent trail preference without a Spanish recognition benchmark.

cases.initial_state: English + Español active; host contains exactly "hjk" with caret at the end; Sound on; Haptic Feedback on.
actions: In settings, turn Sound off while leaving Haptic Feedback on; return to the keyboard and tap lowercase h.
Reopen settings and record both toggle values.
Turn Sound on and Haptic Feedback off; return to the keyboard and tap lowercase j.
Reopen settings and record both toggle values.
expected_outcomes: The host reads exactly "hjkh" after the first tap and exactly "hjkhj" after the second.
The first settings revisit shows Sound off and Haptic Feedback on; the second shows Sound on and Haptic Feedback off.
On hardware with system keyboard clicks enabled and audio audible, the first tap produces no keyboard click and the second produces a system keyboard click.
On hardware capable of keyboard haptics, the first tap produces keyboard haptic feedback and the second does not.
Physical audibility and tactile feedback are marked not observable on a simulator; simulator execution is not blocked by those physical checks.
cases.rationale: Checks independent feedback preferences and return-to-keyboard application with feasible device-specific observations.

cases.initial_state: English active; host contains exactly "hjkh" with caret between j and k; a recorded emoji E is present in recents; Slide to Type off; Show Slide Trail on; Sound off; Haptic Feedback off.
actions: Select Español in language settings and return to the keyboard.
Verify the selected language in settings, then select English + Español and return to the keyboard.
Verify the selected language in settings, then select English and return to the keyboard.
Verify language and all four preference values in settings.
Open recent emojis and select the recorded E once.
expected_outcomes: Each settings revisit shows the language just selected.
Each return to the keyboard preserves the host text exactly "hjkh" and the caret between j and k until E is selected.
At the end, language is English; Slide to Type is off; Show Slide Trail is on; Sound and Haptic Feedback are off.
E remains available in recents through the language changes.
Selecting E produces exactly "hj" followed by E followed by "kh".
cases.rationale: Language round-trip history control covering preference, caret, host, and recent-choice continuity without dictionary or layout-ranking assumptions.
